hypothesis: Data augmentation (not optimizer choice) is the limiting factor in achieving high accuracy on CIFAR-10

comparison_with_iter2.insight: SGD+cosine benefits MORE from augmentation (+16.09%) than Adam (+7.01%), suggesting SGD needs regularization more. With augmentation, SGD+cosine (94.96%) outperforms Adam (90.57%) by 4.39%.

key_findings: Data augmentation is crucial for CIFAR-10 ResNet-18 performance
Standard augmentation pipeline (RandomHorizontalFlip + RandomCrop) provides ~6-16% accuracy boost
SGD+cosine with proper patience (40 epochs) allows full learning rate schedule to run
With augmentation, both optimizers converge to different plateaus: Adam ~90.6%, SGD+cosine ~95%
Early stopping with Adam patience=15 stops at epoch ~37-57, SGD+cosine patience=40 runs many more epochs

root_cause_analysis.iter2_underperformance: Both optimizer implementations were correct, but neither had data augmentation
root_cause_analysis.augmentation_missing: Iterations 1 and 2 only used normalization transforms, not augmentation
root_cause_analysis.why_sgd_worse_in_iter2: Without augmentation, SGD became overly constrained and plateaued at 78.87%. With augmentation providing regularization, SGD+cosine's cosine schedule benefit becomes apparent.
root_cause_analysis.why_adam_better_in_iter2: Adam's adaptive learning rate provides implicit regularization even without augmentation, but still struggles to pass 84% without data augmentation
